Message__c: Apex code performs SOQL/DML without enforcing field-level security — user may access or modify fields they are not authorized to see.
Remediation__c: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in SOQL or Security.stripInaccessible() before DML to enforce FLS in Apex.

Message__c: Apex code builds a SOQL query by concatenating unvalidated user input — allows an attacker to manipulate the query.
Remediation__c: Use bind variables (:variable) in SOQL instead of string concatenation with user-controlled input.

Message__c: Apex class does not declare a sharing keyword — record-level security may not be enforced for the running user.
Remediation__c: Add 'with sharing' to the class declaration; use 'inherited sharing' when the sharing context should come from the caller.

Message__c: LWC component sets innerHTML directly — any unsanitized value creates a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
Remediation__c: Replace innerHTML assignments with safe Lightning DOM APIs (e.g. lwc:inner-html with sanitization) or template literals.

Message__c: LWC component contains console.log / console.error statements — debug output should not reach production.
Remediation__c: Remove console statements before deployment or wrap them behind a debug flag.

Message__c: LWC component uses unsupported asynchronous patterns (setTimeout / setInterval) that may not behave correctly in the LWC engine.
Remediation__c: Replace with @wire decorators or async/await on imperative Apex calls.

Message__c: Apex code performs SOQL queries or DML inside a loop — consumes governor limits rapidly and fails on bulk operations.
Remediation__c: Move all SOQL/DML outside loops; use collections and bulkification patterns.
